nouveautes.titre: Epidemiological, etiological, and antifungal resistance patterns of vulvovaginal Candida spp. infections in Cameroon: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
nouveautes.resume: Vulvovaginal candidiasis is a common fungal infection, mainly due to Candida species, affecting two-thirds of women globally at least once in their lifetime. Here, we conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO ID: CRD420261368975) of the epidemiology, aetiology, and drug resistance profiles of vulvovaginal Candida infections and VVC in Cameroon. Databases were queried to identify all eligible papers.

nouveautes.resume: KOH microscopy is a routine method to determine the presence of fungal elements in infected tissue. nouveautes.titre: Fungal representation in the environment of penguin communities in the French Southern territories.
nouveautes.resume: Penguins are highly susceptible to airborne mycoses, and aspergillosis due to Aspergillus fumigatus (recently classified as priority pathogen by WHO) is common in captivity; however, environmental fungal diversity and exposure risk in natural, non-temperate breeding habitats remain poorly described. During one year, monthly environmental sampling was performed from four different soils of Crozet archipelago, in French Southern Territories, around three penguin colonies.

nouveautes.titre: Transgenic Plasmodium berghei expressing P. vivax pre-erythrocytic antigens SSP3 and SPECT1 to elucidate their efficacy towards vaccine development.
nouveautes.resume: The development of an efficacious vaccine against Plasmodium vivax malaria remains a top global health priority. P. vivax forms hypnozoites, dormant forms of the parasite in the liver that can become reactivated after a few months or even years, causing relapse malaria and enhancing transmission. Therefore, targeting antigens expressed during the pre-erythrocytic stages offers the potential to prevent clinical malaria from both primary and relapse infections.

nouveautes.titre: A Novel Aspergillus Galactomannan Chemiluminescence Immunoassay: Evaluation for Diagnosis of Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis in a Multicenter Controlled Study.
nouveautes.resume: The Aspergillus galactomannan chemiluminescence immunoassay (GM-CLIA) is a novel non-culture-based test applied in the detection of GM antigen in serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF). This multicenter, retrospective, and controlled study aims to investigate its diagnostic value for invasive aspergillosis (IA). A total of 246 serum and 228 BALF samples were obtained from IA patients (n = 229) and non-IA (n = 236) patients between March 2023 and July 2024.

nouveautes.titre: Effectiveness of respiratory syncytial virus immunisation in practice.
nouveautes.resume: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) affects all ages, with infants and older adults most affected by severe disease. The RSV prevention landscape includes 39 candidates in clinical development, alongside setbacks such as the discontinuation of a promising paediatric live-attenuated vaccine candidate. Several products have been approved, including a maternal vaccine, infant monoclonal antibodies, and vaccines for older adults and adults at high risk.

nouveautes.titre: Projected Effect of 2026 Federal Changes to the Childhood Immunization Schedule on Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infections in the United States.
nouveautes.resume: To project the effect of vaccine policy changes, if fully implemented, on chronic HBV infections. Compared with the universal birth-dose strategy (255 childhood infections [95% UI, 130 to 530]), the deferred and shared decision-making strategies would increase chronic HBV infections in the 2026 birth cohort by 19% to 303 (95% UI, 155 to 610) and by 83% to 467 (95% UI, 209 to 1032), respectively.

nouveautes.titre: West Nile : saison 2026 exceptionnellement intense en Europe
nouveautes.resume: L’ECDC décrit un nombre record de cas humains signalés au 7 octobre et une extension géographique vers le nord de l’Europe.
nouveautes.impact_pratique: Évoquer les formes neuro-invasives chez les patients à risque et rester attentif aux transmissions autochtones.

nouveautes.titre: Essai randomisé : verrou minocycline–EDTA–éthanol sur cathéters
nouveautes.resume: L’essai multicentrique rapporte une rétention du cathéter plus fréquente avec le verrou expérimental qu’avec le verrou standard (57 % contre 38 %).
nouveautes.impact_pratique: Donnée intéressante pour les stratégies de conservation de cathéter, sans généralisation hors critères d’inclusion ni changement de protocole sans analyse complète.

publications.reference: Pourghazi F · Open Forum Infect Dis · 2026; 13(10):ofag657
publications.resume: Fungal periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) is a rare but serious complication of joint arthroplasty, with variable management and poorly defined outcomes. publications.titre: Effectiveness of respiratory syncytial virus immunisation in practice.
publications.resume: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) affects all ages, with infants and older adults most affected by severe disease. Several products have been approved, including a maternal vaccine, infant monoclonal antibodies, and vaccines for older adults and adults at high risk.
